title: The Lantern Room
description: The chapter has sat once more at the Spire's foot, by daylight, on one line: whether the Hearthspire is lit again. The stair goes on up from the last landing to the lantern room, where the singing is.

stages.text: The chapter sat on the one line and wrote that it does not choose: the hand that carried the last coal down carries it up. The stair on up from the last landing is open.

In the lantern room the cradle is cold, and the Hollow Choir stands round it: everything the Firstflame ate that had nobody left to go home to. Isolde Vane told what lighting it again would cost. Nobody asked the Wakebearer for anything.
At the cradle the Wakebearer chose. The chapter is counting at the foot of the east stair.
